weekly_thesis: 이번 주의 핵심은 VLA, robot data, world model, geometry, VLM reliability가 따로 움직인 것이 아니라 모두 '행동을 믿기 전에 어떤 중간 evidence state를 노출하고 검증할 것인가'로 수렴했다는 점입니다. 월요일의 robot-rendered state와 gradient-free guidance는 화요일의 depth/tactile state, 수요일의 causal modality evidence, 목요일의 real-time execution plus repair, 금요일의 counterfactual action drift와 ambient state capture로 이어졌습니다. APRL 관점에서 이번 주의 승부처는 더 큰 backbone이 아니라 action-sensitive data, robot-usable geometry, runtime repair, evidence-routed VLM을 같은 closed-loop failure protocol 안에서 비교할 수 있는 자산을 먼저 소유하는 것입니다.

paper_autopsies.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
paper_autopsies.status: Tier A - official arXiv HTML verified
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Many VLA systems route visual observations through a large language model before actions, which makes the LLM the central execution interface even for routine manipulation.
paper_autopsies.friction: That pathway spends memory and latency every policy call, making high-frequency local control hard even when the instruction has already specified the manipulation intent.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: For execution-level control, the policy may only need language-conditioned visual features, not open-ended language generation at every action step.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: TurboVLA reformulates the V-to-L-to-A pipeline as direct V+L-to-A fusion with lightweight bidirectional interaction and continuous action chunk prediction.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: Independent visual and instruction encoders exchange information through a compact interaction module, then a decoder emits continuous action chunks without centering an LLM.

decisive_evidence.claim: The paper reports compact local deployment with 0.2B parameters, 0.9 GB inference VRAM, and 31.2 ms policy latency.
The method is framed as a move from LLM-centric VLA to direct visual-instruction fusion for continuous control.
LIBERO results are reported together with parameter count, VRAM, latency, and success rate on a single RTX 4090.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If the latency gain disappears on real robot sensing and preprocessing, or if direct fusion loses robustness under compositional instructions, the method is a benchmark-speed win rather than a general VLA interface shift.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Removing the LLM can also remove useful reasoning or recovery behavior. The paper needs failure cases where the fast policy chooses the wrong object or phase.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Treat the VLA pathway as an execution interface: log instruction embedding age, visual token set, action chunk, latency, and failure phase.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: The idea transfers to language-conditioned manipulation with stable skill semantics. It is less direct for tasks that require open-ended replanning or dialogue.

paper_autopsies.title: It's Not Just More Demos: Counterfactual Action Sensitivity Coverage for Data-Efficient Robust Robot Imitation
paper_autopsies.status: Tier A - official arXiv HTML verified
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Imitation policies are often repaired by collecting more diverse demonstrations without knowing which examples address the trained policy's brittle action boundary.
paper_autopsies.friction: Lighting, distractors, color, or local support changes can preserve the task but still push the policy action away from the expert action.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: The useful new data is the data that covers action drift under task-preserving nuisances.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: CFNBC generates paired clean and nuisance observations, measures action drift, and selects counterfactual examples for targeted robustness repair.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: A nominal policy is probed with counterfactual nuisance grids; high-response examples define repair candidates for fine-tuning under a low data budget.

decisive_evidence.claim: The paper defines representative task-preserving nuisance conditions including appearance, lighting, distractor, local support, and multi-factor combinations.
The official HTML reports response-guided repair improving all-nuisance success by +0.66 in cube transfer and +0.44 in cube stacking at matched low budgets.
The method separates task-preserving counterfactuals, action drift, response-guided repair selection, and repair fine-tuning.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If action-drift-selected examples do not transfer to held-out nuisance families, the method is selecting visible variation rather than causal brittleness.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Counterfactual rendering can preserve the expert action by construction while missing real-world nuisance physics or perception artifacts.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Before adding demonstrations, ask which nuisance changes the policy action while preserving the expert action.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: Best for visuomotor imitation with controllable nuisance generation; harder for tasks where the nuisance changes the valid expert action.

paper_autopsies.title: DeVA: Decoupled Video-Action Model with physical guidance for robot policy learning
paper_autopsies.status: Tier A - official arXiv HTML verified
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Video-action models often ask one backbone to learn visual dynamics and action prediction at once, so policy failure is hard to assign to future-frame modeling, geometric grounding, or the action head.
paper_autopsies.friction: Robot actions need spatial contact evidence. A visually plausible future does not tell the action decoder where the robot can safely touch, push, or grasp.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: The policy should expose physical guidance as an intermediate interface, not bury it inside a fused latent sequence.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: DeVA decouples video dynamics from action prediction and injects depth/affordance-style physical tokens into the action stream.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: Layer-wise video features feed an action transformer through cross-attention, while a physical guidance module aggregates multi-level video features into affordance and depth maps that condition action chunks.

decisive_evidence.claim: The model explicitly separates video dynamics modeling from action prediction.
The physical guidance module converts depth and affordance estimates into tokens for the action head.
The method is organized around a decoupled video-action architecture with multi-level feature interaction.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If physical guidance helps only on visually easy manipulation tasks, the module may be a regularizer rather than a real action-validity interface.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Depth and affordance maps can be confidently wrong under occlusion, transparent objects, or deformable contact. The paper's interface still needs failure labels.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Split a robot policy into visual prediction, physical guidance, and action emission; then test which interface actually predicts rollout failure.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: The interface transfers best to tasks where depth and affordance are visible before contact. It needs tactile or force evidence for hidden-contact regimes.

paper_autopsies.title: CheckVLA: Execution-Time Verification with Action-Conditioned World Model for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
paper_autopsies.status: Tier A - official arXiv HTML verified
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Long-horizon VLA policies often commit action chunks and keep executing after a deviation, because commit-time confidence cannot see post-dispatch drift.
paper_autopsies.friction: Observation-only anomaly detection cannot tell the difference between expected consequences of the action and unexplained changes that require intervention.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: A verifier should predict the world conditioned on the remaining committed action, then calibrate a risk trigger before rewriting the suffix.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: CheckVLA adds a frozen action-conditioned world model, conformal risk threshold, latency-aware suffix rewriting, and episodic context to the execution loop.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: Rolling prediction estimates near-term consequences; a causal risk head compares prediction to observation; threshold crossing controls repair timing and suffix retention.

decisive_evidence.claim: The verifier predicts short-horizon features from latest observation and remaining actions, then uses a conformal threshold for the first intervention.
The framework couples action-conditioned rolling prediction, calibrated risk triggering, latency-aware suffix rewriting, and episodic context.
The comparison table marks CheckVLA as covering action-conditioned signal, calibrated trigger, in-chunk repair, latency awareness, and episodic memory.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If the world model is wrong in exactly the OOD states that matter, calibrated risk can be confidently late or confidently unnecessary.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: A separate verifier can learn benchmark-specific consequence features. It must be tested on natural disturbances and not only injected deviations.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Log committed action, predicted consequence, observed consequence, risk trace, threshold crossing, suffix rewrite, and final recovery.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: This transfers to chunked mobile manipulation and navigation. It is harder for high-rate contact control where consequence prediction must run at tactile timescales.

paper_autopsies.title: EgoGenesis: Egocentric World-Action Modeling with Online Anchored Projective Memory and Action-3D RoPE
paper_autopsies.status: Tier A - official arXiv HTML verified
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Egocentric video generation can look plausible while camera motion, gripper trajectory, and object interaction drift away from the intended action.
paper_autopsies.friction: Embodied data is scarce, but synthetic egocentric video is not useful for robot learning unless it preserves scene anchors and action geometry.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: A generated manipulation video should remember the first-frame 3D scene and encode end-effector motion in camera-aware coordinates.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: EgoGenesis adds Online Anchored Projective Memory and Action-3D RoPE to a pretrained video prior for controllable egocentric interaction generation.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: OAPM stores anchored and recent 3D scene slots, while A3D-RoPE injects metric action geometry into skeleton-to-video cross-attention during autoregressive generation.

decisive_evidence.claim: The paper diagnoses uncontrolled camera motion and gripper trajectory drift in existing egocentric video generators.
The architecture shows OAPM maintaining anchored and recent 3D scene slots and A3D-RoPE injecting action geometry.
Generation quality is compared on held-out trajectories under identical scene and action conditioning.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If generated trajectories improve video metrics but not downstream real-robot WAM generalization, anchored memory is not preserving the right control variable.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: A3D action geometry can still be a clean skeleton prior that hides contact ambiguity, force, and gripper-object slip.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Treat generated egocentric data as valid only when it preserves anchor state, end-effector geometry, and downstream policy effect.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: Transfers to visuomotor manipulation data augmentation; less direct for contact-rich tasks without tactile or force state.

new: Counterfactual action drift and failure-to-correction targets became explicit data-selection mechanisms on July 31.
Ambient capture moved embodied data from video archive to synchronized state engine.
strengthening: The July action-state contract thread strengthened every day from robot rendering to tactile state, causal modality evidence, real-time execution, and runtime repair.
Robot-usable geometry appeared repeatedly as localization, semantic association, articulated prior, radar odometry, and action-conditioned map state.
commoditizing: Generic VLA scale and generic video/world-model quality are less defensible unless they expose an intervention-ready evidence field.
contradiction: Fast direct VLA execution reduces latency, while verifier and repair modules add diagnostic depth; the useful boundary is task-dependent and needs controlled measurement.
missing_axis: The corpus still lacks a shared multi-sensor closed-loop benchmark that evaluates action evidence, geometry evidence, and VLM evidence in the same episodes.

strategy_board.why_now: Five consecutive daily batches made action validity depend on exposed intermediate evidence rather than final success alone.
strategy_board.contrarian_bet: APRL should own the failure-evidence protocol before competing on another VLA backbone.
strategy_board.one_week_probe: Instrument two manipulation tasks with action chunk, physical-state prediction, causal modality delta, verifier risk, and repair decision.
strategy_board.four_week_build: Compare TurboVLA-style direct execution, DeVA-style physical guidance, IDR-style modality diagnosis, and CheckVLA-style repair under one failure-labeled protocol.
strategy_board.success_metric: At least one evidence field predicts terminal failure two steps earlier than success history with AUC >= 0.75 or improves recovery by 10 points.
strategy_board.stop_condition: If evidence fields do not outperform task ID and previous action error, narrow to one failure family before scaling.
strategy_board.paper_path: Execution-evidence contracts for reliable VLA control.
strategy_board.asset_path: Reusable APRL VLA failure-evidence protocol and annotated rollout set.

strategy_board.why_now: July 31 made action drift a concrete selection criterion, while earlier days showed typed data-source and fidelity constraints.
strategy_board.contrarian_bet: Instead of collecting broader demos, select examples that move the trained policy's action boundary.
strategy_board.one_week_probe: Generate nuisance pairs for lighting, distractor, support, object pose, and moving-object state on one imitation policy.
strategy_board.four_week_build: Compare random demos, fidelity-filtered demos, action-drift examples, and failure-correction examples under the same data budget.
strategy_board.success_metric: OOD success improves by at least 10 points at equal budget, with selected examples explaining a specific failure family.
strategy_board.stop_condition: If action-drift examples do not beat random additions on two nuisance families, switch to real perturbation collection.
strategy_board.paper_path: Data-efficient imitation repair through action-sensitive counterfactual coverage.
strategy_board.asset_path: Counterfactual data-selection harness plus failure-correction library.

strategy_board.why_now: 3D/Scene and world-action papers repeatedly moved from visual quality to sensor source, uncertainty, contact, and action use.
strategy_board.contrarian_bet: APRL can avoid photorealism competition by owning task-grounded geometry validity.
strategy_board.one_week_probe: Build a small route plus tabletop card with map source, uncertainty, action use, and expected failure mode for each geometry field.
strategy_board.four_week_build: Compare visual-inertial SLAM, semantic-object maps, Gaussian/object maps, anchored 3D world models, and tactile world models on downstream recovery.
strategy_board.success_metric: Geometry/world-state fields explain at least three distinct failure families and improve navigation or manipulation recovery over visual-only state.
strategy_board.stop_condition: If fields only correlate with visual quality and not recovery, split the work into localization-only and contact-only protocols.
strategy_board.paper_path: Robot-usable geometry state as an execution contract.
